items.text: Exactness at the middle

Given $x_i/f_i^{\,\cdot}\in M_{f_i}$ with equal images in $M_{f_if_j}$: $(f_jx_i-f_ix_j)$ is killed by a power of $f_if_j$. Finite subcovering (the kernel does not change); one exponent $m$ for all $i,j$.
y_i=x_if_i^m,\quad \text{elements}\ \frac{y_i}{f_i^{m'}},\qquad f_j^{m'}y_i-f_i^{m'}y_j=0
f^n=\sum_ig_if_i^{m'}\quad(\text{the}\ X_{f_i}\ \text{do not change on replacing}\ f_i\ \text{by a power})
y=\sum_jg_jy_j;\qquad\text{claim: } y/f^n\mapsto y_i/f_i^{m'}\ \text{in}\ M_{f_i}
f_i^{m'}y=\sum_jg_jf_i^{m'}y_j=\sum_jg_jf_j^{m'}y_i=f^ny_i
So localisation w.r.t. $f$ = taking sections of the sheaf $\widetilde M$ over $X_f\subset X=\operatorname{Spec}A$; $\widetilde M(X)=M_1=M$.
Fourth description of $M_f$
M\otimes_AA_f\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }M_f
Localising = base change to $A_f$ (universal property: $N$ with $f$ invertible is an $A_f$-module).
The exactness as a statement on rings
A'=\prod_iA_{f_i},\qquad A'\otimes_AA'=\prod_{i,j}A_{f_if_j};\qquad 0\to M\to M\otimes_AA'\rightrightarrows M\otimes_AA''\quad(A''=A'\otimes_AA')
Not exact in general ($A'=0$); exact when $A'$ is faithfully flat over $A$, as is the case when the $f_i$ generate the unit ideal.
Flat and faithfully flat
$M$ is flat if $N\mapsto N\otimes_AM$ is exact (it is right exact; flat = injections go to injections):
N'\to N\to N''\to0\ \text{exact}\Rightarrow M\otimes N'\to M\otimes N\to M\otimes N''\to0\ \text{exact};\qquad N'\hookrightarrow N\Rightarrow M\otimes N'\hookrightarrow M\otimes N
$M$ is faithfully flat if $T_M=M\otimes-$ is exact and faithful, i.e. $M\otimes N=0\Rightarrow N=0$. Then $N'\to N$ is injective (surjective, an isomorphism) iff $M\otimes N'\to M\otimes N$ is.
An $A$-algebra $A'$ is faithfully flat if it is so as a module; $N\mapsto N\otimes_AA'$ is the base change functor.
Faithfully flat descent
Claim. $A'$ faithfully flat over $A$ $\Rightarrow$ for every $A$-module $M$, with $A''=A'\otimes_AA'$,
0\to M\to M_{A'}\rightrightarrows M_{A''}\ \text{exact, i.e. } M=H^0(A'/A,M);\qquad H^i(A'/A,M)=0\ \ (i>0)
Proof. Enough to check after a faithfully flat base change $A\to B$; take $B=A'$: then $B'=A'\otimes A'\to B$ is an algebra section, and the complex becomes trivially exact (contracting homotopy).
